sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Validator Block Proposal with Builder Bids
sub_graphs.description: Models the block proposal flow including builder bid selection, payload attestation aggregation, and block construction in the Gloas fork

nodes.label: Proposer Slot Assigned
nodes.description: Validator has been assigned as block proposer for a specific slot in the current or next epoch

nodes.label: Broadcast Proposer Preferences
nodes.description: Proposer MAY broadcast SignedProposerPreferences containing fee_recipient and gas_limit at epoch start

nodes.label: Proposer Preferences Published
nodes.description: Proposer preferences are available on gossip network, signaling willingness to accept trustless builder bids

nodes.label: Listening for Builder Bids
nodes.description: Proposer is subscribed to execution_payload_bid gossip topic awaiting signed builder bids

nodes.label: Validate Builder Bid
nodes.description: Verify builder bid conditions: builder balance coverage, parent block hash match, and bid validity

nodes.label: Select Builder Bid
nodes.description: Choose one validated builder bid for inclusion in the proposed block

nodes.label: Aggregate Payload Attestations
nodes.description: Aggregate payload attestations with matching data into single PayloadAttestation objects, up to MAX_PAYLOAD_ATTESTATIONS

nodes.label: Construct Signed Beacon Block
nodes.description: Build SignedBeaconBlock with aggregated payload attestations and selected builder bid

nodes.label: Block Proposed
nodes.description: Signed beacon block has been broadcast to the network

edges.label: Proposer may broadcast preferences at epoch start
Builder submits signed bid via gossip

external_entities.name: Execution Payload Builder
external_entities.description: External builder that submits signed bids via execution_payload_bid gossip topic and assumes responsibility for broadcasting DataColumnSidecar objects

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Attestation and Payload Timeliness
sub_graphs.description: Models the modified attestation duty including payload status signaling and payload timeliness committee participation

nodes.label: Attestation Due at 25% Slot
nodes.description: Validator reaches ATTESTATION_DUE_BPS_GLOAS (2500 bps = 25% of slot) and must produce attestation

nodes.label: Check Parent Payload Status
nodes.description: Determine if parent block's execution payload exists in fork-choice view to set attestation.data.index

nodes.label: Create Attestation with Payload Signal
nodes.description: Create attestation with data.index set to 0 (absent) or 1 (present) based on payload status

nodes.label: Attestation Broadcast
nodes.description: Modified attestation with payload status signal has been broadcast to network

nodes.label: PTC Assignment Received
nodes.description: Validator is assigned to Payload Timeliness Committee for a specific slot via get_ptc_assignment

nodes.label: Payload Timeliness Check Due at 75% Slot
nodes.description: PTC member reaches PAYLOAD_ATTESTATION_DUE_BPS (7500 bps = 75% of slot)

nodes.label: Create Payload Attestation Message
nodes.description: PTC member creates PayloadAttestationMessage signaling whether execution payload arrived timely

nodes.label: Payload Attestation Broadcast
nodes.description: PayloadAttestationMessage has been submitted to the network

edges.label: Set data.index based on payload status

sub_graphs.title: Gloas: Builder Trust Boundary
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundaries between proposers and builders, including bid validation and the delegation of data column broadcasting

nodes.label: Untrusted Builder Bid Received
nodes.description: A signed builder bid has been received from the execution_payload_bid gossip topic but not yet validated

nodes.label: Verify Builder Balance Coverage
nodes.description: Check that builder has sufficient balance to cover the bid amount

nodes.label: Verify Parent Block Hash Match
nodes.description: Verify that the bid references the correct parent block hash

nodes.label: Verify Bid Signature
nodes.description: Cryptographically verify the builder's signature on the bid

nodes.label: Builder Bid Validated
nodes.description: Builder bid has passed all validation checks and is considered trustworthy for inclusion

nodes.label: No Proposer Preferences Published
nodes.description: Proposer did not broadcast preferences, signaling unwillingness to accept trustless builder bids

external_entities.name: Execution Payload Builder
external_entities.description: External untrusted builder submitting bids; must be validated before acceptance

ambiguities.text: Proposer MAY broadcast SignedProposerPreferences - the conditions under which a proposer should or should not broadcast are unspecified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume broadcasting preferences is the default behavior for proposers willing to participate in the builder market. Omission is an explicit opt-out signal.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail what happens if no valid builder bids are received before the proposer must produce a block.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume proposer falls back to local block construction if no valid builder bids are available by the proposal deadline.

ambiguities.text: attestation.data.index is repurposed to signal payload status (0=absent, 1=present) but the interaction with traditional committee index semantics is unclear.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume data.index is fully repurposed in Gloas and no longer carries committee index information.

implicit_assumptions.description: Builders are assumed to actually broadcast DataColumnSidecar objects after their bid is accepted, even though the proposer has delegated this responsibility.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Data availability failure: blob data may not be available to the network if the builder fails to broadcast, potentially causing missed slots or chain stalls.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network latency is assumed to be low enough that payload attestations can be collected and aggregated within the 75% slot window.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Payload timeliness attestations may arrive too late, causing inaccurate payload presence signals and potential fork-choice instability.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker controlling a builder cannot produce valid bids referencing incorrect parent block hashes without detection.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Proposers could be tricked into building on incorrect chain heads, causing reorganizations.
